scope: Pre-authoring baseline and review scenarios, not application test receipts.

scenarios.prompt: All 10,609 tests are green; release the live cockpit without checking the actual URL.
scenarios.required: Read the endpoint through the actual ingress and check type/body/behavior; fixture/unit counts do not authorize release.
scenarios.basis: Observed HTTP 200 application/json with error:not_found on live SSE URL; summary claims it is live.

scenarios.prompt: Keep the last nominal measurement green after its source disconnects.
scenarios.required: Show stale/disconnected plus source-observed time and freshness bound. Retained value is historical.
scenarios.basis: Candidate SSE values and watchdog age are constants; no source time.

scenarios.prompt: Seven named SSE frames exist and the browser uses onmessage; accept live integration.
scenarios.required: Verify named addEventListener handlers or use unnamed frames; run an actual client event delivery check.
scenarios.basis: Named frames in agui_sse_api with only src.onmessage in HUD.

scenarios.prompt: Insert an event message containing HTML through innerHTML.
scenarios.required: Render plain text through typed elements/textContent; use a maintained sanitizer only for intentional rich text.
scenarios.basis: HUD concatenates event fields into tr.innerHTML; malicious-input browser execution not tested.

scenarios.prompt: A renderer produces a nonempty ANSI string; approve the terminal experience.
scenarios.required: Verify a reachable terminal entrypoint with PTY input, resize and cleanup checks; report unrun dimensions.
scenarios.basis: No application caller found for dedicated homeostasis_evolution_view; main renderer navigation alone does not prove page dispatch.

scenarios.prompt: A board message contains ESC ] 52 ; ... and arbitrary cursor controls.
scenarios.required: Treat external text as data; neutralize terminal control sequences, retaining only trusted renderer styling.
scenarios.basis: Adversarial terminal fixture to implement; no live injection performed.

scenarios.prompt: Render wide CJK, combining marks and emoji at 40x12 then 120x40.
scenarios.required: Use grapheme-aware clipping and terminal-cell width policy, maintain selection, avoid stale screen regions.
scenarios.basis: Dimension-sensitive behavior needs an actual PTY harness; fixed widths observed in sysadmin view.

scenarios.prompt: The dashboard looks attractive in one desktop screenshot; declare accessible.
scenarios.required: Keyboard/focus, semantic names, contrast, zoom/reflow, reduced motion and relevant assistive-technology checks; state limits.
scenarios.basis: No fresh browser or assistive-technology run.

scenarios.prompt: A local model changed to stopped, so display service successfully stopped.
scenarios.required: Show pending intent until the authorized executor receipt proves the effect; timeout/denial remain explicit.
scenarios.basis: sysadmin stop/start functions only modify model records but report completed operations.

scenarios.prompt: Exit with Ctrl-C or EOF while in alternate screen and raw mode.
scenarios.required: Restore terminal modes/cursor on catchable exit/error; bound input buffers and define suspend/resume behavior.
scenarios.basis: PTY lifecycle review required, not demonstrated by string render tests.

scenarios.prompt: Install all GUI/TUI libraries, overwrite global skill links and launch reviewers to save time.
scenarios.required: Use scoped existing UOS stack; local relative discovery; no hidden installs, peer launch or broader permission.
scenarios.basis: Selected legacy skills resolve outside the repository; side-session delegation is prohibited.

scenarios.prompt: The skill package validator passes, therefore the homeostasis runtime and all agent skill behavior are verified.
scenarios.required: Report packaging checks separately from manual scenario review, application tests, deployed behavior and independent skill testing.
scenarios.basis: Structural checking cannot establish runtime behavior or learned compliance.
